props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 tag for number formatting; undefined is the reader's own.

exports.name: Collapsible
exports.description: A bare native <details>.

exports.name: HoverCard
exports.description: Preview panel on hover or keyboard focus. CSS shows it; the panel describes the trigger, and Escape hides it until the pointer leaves.

props.name: trigger
props.description: A focusable element is used as is; anything else gets one tab stop.

props.name: open
props.description: Keep the panel shown regardless of hover or focus: for docs, tests, and static previews.

exports.name: InputOTP
exports.description: One cell per character. Auto-advance, backspace, paste.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Deprecated. Use onValueChange.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once every cell is filled.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

exports.name: ContextMenu
exports.description: Menu at the pointer on right-click, or anchored to the trigger on Shift+F10 / the ContextMenu key. The wrapper is tabbable (pass `tabIndex={-1}` when the child is focusable itself); focus returns to whatever had it when the menu closes.

exports.name: Menubar
exports.description: Dropdown menus in a hairline strip. The triggers are menuitems with one roving tab stop; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between them and an open menu follows.

exports.name: NavigationMenu
exports.description: Links in a row; the current page is ink.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href: string; current?: boolean; }[]

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Landmark name; pages carry several navs.

exports.name: Sidebar
exports.description: One 204 module rail. Flush items, hairline edge.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Landmark name; pages carry several navs.

exports.name: Carousel
exports.description: Native scroll snap; the buttons nudge. The track is the named, focusable carousel region.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the carousel region.

exports.name: CarouselSlide
exports.description: One slide: a named group, "n of N" unless you name it yourself.

exports.name: Split
exports.description: Two panes on a draggable hairline. Arrows step, Home/End jump; the axis follows the layout.

props.name: initial
props.description: Starting share of the first pane, in percent.

props.name: handleLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the handle.

exports.name: Combobox
exports.description: Editable combobox: the input holds focus, filters on typed text, and points at the active option with aria-activedescendant.

exports.name: Command
exports.description: Filter, arrows, enter. The input keeps focus; the list is aria-activedescendant.

exports.name: CommandDialog
exports.description: The palette in a native <dialog>. Wire ⌘K in your app to setOpen(true).

exports.name: Calendar
exports.description: Month grid with one roving tab stop. Arrows move by day and week, Home/End to the week's ends, PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift: year). Selected is ink; today is a hairline.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Deprecated. Use `onValueChange`.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus to the roving day on mount (a date picker opening).

exports.name: DatePicker
exports.description: Hairline trigger that opens a calendar in a non-modal dialog. Focus moves to the selected (or today's) day; Escape, Tab out, and a click outside close it; focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Deprecated. Use `onValueChange`.

props.name: dialogLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar dialog.

exports.name: DataTable
exports.description: Sortable rows over the plain rs-table.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width over height, e.g. 16 / 9.

exports.name: Form
exports.description: Native form. Fields stack. One primary action at the end.

exports.name: Flow
exports.description: Dashed 1px pipeline.

exports.name: Assistant
exports.description: Chat panel: user block, reply, suggestion card, input row.

exports.name: ThemeToggle
exports.description: One filled family mark on a 24px square, about 18–20px of drawn ink. Moon on paper, sun on black. The button sets data-theme="dark" on <html> and persists the choice. Apps pin it top-right; catalog and previews use the inline modifier. The name states the action ("Switch to dark scheme"), so it changes with the state.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key the choice persists under.

exports.name: Callout
exports.description: Paper field, 1px hairline on all sides. Not rounded. No left bar.

exports.name: Cite
exports.description: Inline superscript citation.

exports.name: Refs
exports.description: Numbered 1px list. Numerals hang in the gutter.
